title: fix: disclose community model data handling
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Privacy Policy disclosures for external community endpoints and Pollinations-hosted prompt agents.
- Adds Terms obligations for community providers and public agent creators.
- Shows warnings in the Community catalog and public publishing forms, and clarifies the provider profile link.
- Verifies Enter with `npm run build:frontend`, `npm run typecheck`, and live local frontend/API health checks.
- Public-site `npm run build` remains blocked by existing missing `react-router-dom` and React type conflicts unrelated to these Markdown changes.

gist.headline: Know Where Prompts Pollinate
gist.blurb: Community endpoints and public prompt agents now come with clearer signposts about who handles the data. The garden is still open; the labels are simply easier to read.
gist.summary: Added Privacy Policy and Terms disclosures for external community endpoints and Pollinations-hosted prompt agents, plus in-product warnings in the Community catalog and public publishing forms.
gist.impact: Users can now see clearer data-handling context before using a community provider or publishing a public agent, while providers and creators have explicit platform obligations.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a thoughtful garden guide, placing clear little information signs beside community-powered code-plants and public-agent seed packets. A friendly CRT monitor robot reads a provider profile card, while soft privacy-shield icons and labeled pathways make the shared garden feel transparent and welcoming.
